CustomField.description: Deal-tracker buckets, derived from stage + deal category. Reporting-only projection - automation must branch on StageName/Deal_Category__c, never on this formula (before-save flows cannot read formula fields).
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISPICKVAL(Deal_Category__c,'Dead'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Dead/Pass')), 'Dead', IF(ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Closed Won'), 'Bought/Closed', IF(ISPICKVAL(StageName,'About to Close'), 'About to Close', IF(ISPICKVAL(StageName,'PSA'), 'PSA', IF(ISPICKVAL(StageName,'LOI'), 'LOI', 'Interested Deals')))))
CustomField.label: Deal Tracker Bucket
